topic: 导出通道 vs 运行时 model_url —— 差异与影响

critical_finding_file_name_ignored.claim: download_with_name ignores the file_name extension entirely; always returns the same meshopt GLB
critical_finding_file_name_ignored.evidence: 6 calls with .glb/.stl/.obj/.fbx/.usdz/.3mf -> identical S3 key tripo_pbr_model_<opid>_meshopt.glb, identical 15,805,980 bytes, magic b'glTF' every time
critical_finding_file_name_ignored.implication: file_name is a DISPLAY NAME, not a format request. There is NO free format-conversion path.

answer_q1_same_as_member_download.verdict: GEOMETRY+TEXTURE: identical source artifact. FORMAT: different.
answer_q1_same_as_member_download.same: The meshopt GLB IS the generated model's native stored form. Membership export would re-serialize this same mesh. Vertex data, UVs, PBR textures are not a degraded 'preview' version - 1,987,714 tris with 3 baked textures is the full product.
answer_q1_same_as_member_download.different: Member export adds: format conversion (USD/FBX/OBJ/STL/3MF), packaging (embedded/zip), custom filename, texture_resolution selection (512/1K/2K/4K/8K), possibly Draco variants. All 403 for free.
answer_q1_same_as_member_download.practical_gap: If your toolchain needs OBJ/FBX/STL (DCC interchange, 3D printing slicers) you must pay. GLB works for web/Blender/Unity/Unreal.

answer_q3_which_software_affected.bufferViews: All 4 (pos/normal/uv/indices) use EXT_meshopt_compression; normals stored as normalized int8 (componentType 5120, quantized)
answer_q3_which_software_affected.size_effect: 15.8MB compressed vs ~56MB raw float estimate => ~3.6x. Indices are UNSIGNED_INT 5125 (not quantized).
affected: Older Blender <3.0 - may fail to load or drop meshes
Software using raw glTF spec only (no extension support) - e.g. some older three.js <r120, some web viewers
Naive glTF parsers that ignore extensionsRequired - silently read empty buffers (this is the dangerous failure mode)
3D-printing slicers (PrusaSlicer/Cura) - they do NOT support glTF extensions well and cannot read meshopt; must convert to STL/OBJ first => this is where membership actually bites
answer_q3_which_software_affected.how_to_convert_free: gltf-transform CLI: gltf-transform optimize --compress meshopt in.glb out.glb  (or decode to uncompressed: gltf-transform copy in.glb out.glb). No Tripo membership involved, local processing.
